name: Harvard University
description: Harvard University is a private Ivy League research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, founded in 1636 as the first college in the American colonies. It comprises Harvard College and twelve graduate and professional schools.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website); the Harvard Club of Singapore serves a community of over 2,400, and Harvard Medical School is on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

livingCosts.summary: Harvard College's own estimate of on-campus housing, food, books and personal costs for a 9-month year. Travel (up to US$5,000), tuition, fees and health insurance are extra.
livingCosts.notes: Harvard College 2026-2027 cost of attendance (on-campus, 9-month academic year). Yearly: housing $14,250, food $8,942, personal = estimated personal expenses $2,500 + estimated books $1,000 = $3,500. Transport 0: 'Estimated transportation costs $0-$5,000' depends on home location. Excludes tuition, fees and health insurance ($4,954).

programmes.name: SM in Computational Science and Engineering (SEAS)
programmes.summary: Tuition for this one-year master's, plus the student health and council fees. Health insurance (can be waived) not included.
programmes.notes: SEAS CSE master of science: full-year tuition $67,504 for the one-year programme (2026-27 GSAS cost of attendance; same figure on the FAS Registrar's tuition-and-fees page). Fees = HUSHP Student Health Fee $972/term x 2 terms + $35 Harvard Griffin GSAS Student Council fee; Student Health Insurance Plan ($2,477/term, waivable) excluded. 2024 from the 2024-2025 GSAS page (SHF $796/term). No 2025 entry: the 2025-26 GSAS cost-of-attendance page has been removed (404 at /apply/ and root paths), the FAS Registrar and GSAS tuition pages show only 2026-27, and the OIRA Fact Book lists only the standard GSAS tuition ($57,328 for 2025-26), not the SEAS SM rate. 2025 row: the 2025-26 GSAS cost-of-attendance page lived at /financial-support/cost-attendance-2025-2026 (not /apply/...); read from Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2025-47 capture 20251107181936. 'Computational Science and Engineering (CSE) and Data Science Master's Programs' table: CSE SM 'Full Year Cost' $65,536 (one-year program). Fees = HUSHP Student Health Fee $900/term x 2 + $35 Harvard Griffin GSAS Student Council fee = $1,835; SHIP ($2,154/term, waivable) excluded.

programmes.name: SM in Data Science (SEAS)
programmes.summary: Average yearly tuition over the 1.5-year programme (a full first year plus one term), plus student health fees. Health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: SEAS Data Science SM: $67,504 first year + $33,752 second year (one term only) = $101,256 over 1.5 years, divided by 1.5 (2026-27 GSAS cost of attendance; same figure on the FAS Registrar's tuition-and-fees page). Fees = HUSHP Student Health Fee $972/term x 2 terms + $35 Harvard Griffin GSAS Student Council fee; Student Health Insurance Plan ($2,477/term, waivable) excluded. 2024 from the 2024-2025 GSAS page (SHF $796/term). No 2025 entry: the 2025-26 GSAS cost-of-attendance page has been removed (404), the FAS Registrar and GSAS tuition pages show only 2026-27, and the OIRA Fact Book lists only the standard GSAS tuition, not the SEAS SM rate. 2025 row: 2025-26 GSAS cost-of-attendance page (https://gsas.harvard.edu/financial-support/cost-attendance-2025-2026, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2025-47 capture 20251107181936): Data Science SM $65,536 (first year) + $32,768 (second year: one term only) = $98,304 over 1.5 years / 1.5 = $65,536. Fees = Student Health Fee $900/term x 2 + $35 GSAS Student Council fee = $1,835; SHIP ($2,154/term, waivable) excluded.

programmes.name: SM in Epidemiology, 80-credit (Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for the 2-year master's, plus the student health fee. Tuition rises each year. Health insurance (can be waived), books, housing and food not included.
programmes.notes: Harvard Chan School 2026-2027 academic year (June 2026 - May 2027) 'Tuition, Fees, and Annual Cost of Attendance' page, Master of Science table, 80-credit 2-year full-time column: tuition $58,272 per year; fees = Student Health Fee $1,944 per year. Student Health Insurance Plan ($4,954, waivable), books, housing, food and the Extended Enrollment Fee excluded. The same per-year rate applies to all 80-credit SM fields; the 42.5-credit one-year SM (for applicants with a doctorate) is $72,936. Page states 'tuition increases annually' and lists only the current year; OIRA Fact Book covers only the 1-year MPH, so no 2024/2025 history. History from earlier versions of the same Harvard Chan 'Tuition, Fees, and Annual Cost of Attendance' page, Master of Science (SM-42.5, SM-60, SM-80) table, 'Master of Science 80-credit, 2 years full-time' column. 2024: '2024 - 2025 Academic Year (June 2024 - May 2025)' version, Common Crawl capture 20250114173917: tuition $54,096 per year, Student Health Fee $1,592 (SHIP $4,202 excluded). 2025: '2025 - 2026 Academic Year (June 2025 - May 2026)' version, Common Crawl captures 20250515231223 and 20250907184801: tuition $56,016 per year, Student Health Fee $1,800 (SHIP $4,308 excluded).

programmes.name: MBA (Harvard Business School)
programmes.summary: Annual MBA tuition plus the student health fee. Health insurance (can be waived), housing and food not included.
programmes.notes: HBS 2026-27 cost of attendance, single student, 9-month academic year: tuition $84,760; fees = HUHS Student Health Fee $1,944. Student Health Insurance Plan ($4,954, waivable), housing and food excluded. 2024 and 2025 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (FY2025 = 2024-25 $76,410, FY2026 = 2025-26 $78,700); fees for those years not found so current value applies. Fee history from earlier versions of the HBS cost-of-attendance page (Wayback captures 20250324041548 'MBA Program: Cost of Attendance for the 2024-2025 Academic Year' and 20250903085624 '... 2025-2026 Academic Year', single student). 2024: tuition $76,410 (matches OIRA), Course & Program Materials Fee $2,650 + HUHS Student Health Fee $1,592 = $4,242. 2025: tuition $78,700, Course & Program Materials Fee $2,800 + SHF $1,800 = $4,600. SHIP ($4,202 / $4,308, waivable) excluded. The billed Course & Program Materials Fee is a compulsory charge in those years and is counted as such; the 2026-27 table (capture 20260723163836) no longer lists it, only tuition $84,760 and SHF $1,944, so the current record's SHF-only fees are consistent with that year.

programmes.name: MD (Harvard Medical School)
programmes.summary: First-year medical school tuition (same for all four years) plus health, technology, materials and activity fees. Health insurance, books and living costs not included.
programmes.notes: HMS 2026-27 MD cost of attendance, Pathways curriculum Year 1 (10-month): tuition $76,828 (same for all four years and for the HST track); fees = university health service fee $1,944 + disability insurance fee $72 + student activities fee $150 + education materials fee $645 (Year 1 Pathways; $314-$907 in other years/tracks) + technology fee $900. Health insurance fee ($4,954, waivable), books, living expenses and board exam fees excluded. MD is graduate-entry (4 years). 2025 tuition from the same page's 2025-26 tables (fees not itemised there); 2024 tuition from Harvard OIRA Fact Book (Medical School, academic year 2025 = 2024-25). Page blocks automated fetches, so checked manually. 2025 fees from the HMS 'Cost of Attendance 2025-26' page, Pathways Year 1 itemised budget (Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2025-43 capture 20251006234408): tuition $73,874; university health service fee $1,800 + disability insurance fee $72 + education materials fee $425 + student activities fee $150 = $2,447 annual; matriculation fee $100 is listed in Year 1 only, so it is entered as one-off (mandatory fees total $2,547). Health insurance fee ($4,308) excluded. 2024 left without fees: the md-program cost pages only exist from 2025 (Wayback/CDX shows no earlier capture of /md-program/cost-aid/cost-attendance), and the 2024 Wayback captures of the older HMS financial-aid section (/departments/financial-aid-harvard-medical-school, 20241102150027) are Incapsula bot-block pages; Common Crawl has no 2024 capture with the budget.
